audit_items.proof_trace: The Sui `Random` shared object (VRF/drand-based) is seeded per-transaction via `TxContext`, making output unpredictable and unique per call. The 36-character, 6-position alphabet yields ~29.9 effective bits of entropy; a minor modulo bias from `generate_u8() % 36` (256 = 7×36+4 makes indices 0–3 ~14% more probable per position) technically exceeds 1/36^6 for a handful of codes but does not enable any practical prediction or targeted collision attack since attackers cannot control the transaction digest used as the PRNG seed.
